name: relay
description: Experimental Codex CLI plugin for verified fresh-thread Goal continuity at automatic compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Verified fresh-thread Goal continuity for Codex CLI
interface.longDescription: At automatic Goal compaction in Codex CLI, Relay attempts a genuinely fresh continuation in the same repository and stops source compaction only after the handoff is verified. Failures defer to native CLI compaction.
defaultPrompt: Keep Relay enabled in Codex CLI while this Goal runs; at automatic compaction it attempts a verified fresh continuation and otherwise lets native CLI compaction proceed.
In a destination thread, inspect live repository state and continue the same Goal objective without relying on the predecessor transcript.
